audit_metadata.title: Phase 9.1 Feature Leakage & Split Integrity Audit

temporal_leakage_verification.target_isolation: PASS: TARGET_COL ('NEXT_AREA_CHANGE' / 'FUSED_TARGET') is constructed strictly from NEXT_AREA - AREA and is completely excluded from feature columns.
temporal_leakage_verification.lag_feature_shifts: PASS: AREA_LAG1-3, AREA_CHANGE_LAG1-3, ROLLING_MEAN_3, and ROLLING_STD_3 are computed strictly using groupby('GLO_ID').shift(1, 2, 3). No contemporaneous or future area enters these features.
temporal_leakage_verification.gap_enforcement: PASS: Gaps between observations strictly set lag features to NaN when year difference exceeds 1, preventing stale lags from acting as continuous temporal steps.

temporal_split_boundary.boundary_evaluation: For training sample at t=2021, target is AREA(2022)-AREA(2021). The 2022 validation predictors X_val are observed at t=2022. Because 1-step-ahead forecasting requires knowing the outcome at t+1 to evaluate model error, this is the standard step-ahead forecast boundary. Expanding-window temporal OOF folds maintain this strict causality (train on years < t).

status_of_2024_data.reason: For AREA_YEAR == 2024, NEXT_YEAR (2025) is not available in the dataset. Thus NEXT_AREA_CHANGE is NaN for all 2024 observations.
status_of_2024_data.prior_use_detail: The 2024 AREA values were directly consumed as the NEXT_AREA target for the 2023 test cohort: NEXT_AREA_CHANGE(2023) = AREA(2024) - AREA(2023). Therefore, 2024 observations cannot be treated as an untouched future holdout.

spatial_leakage_verification.risk_assessment: HIGH RISK if random row-level splitting is used. In random row splits, observations of the SAME lake across different years (e.g. 2018 in train, 2019 in test) leak permanent lake morphology, elevation, and location.
spatial_leakage_verification.mitigation_requirement: All cross-validation and evaluation MUST use grouped splits: GroupKFold(groups=GLO_ID) or spatial basin holdouts (e.g., train on Koshi+Karnali, validate on Gandaki).

preprocessing_leakage_verification.imputation_safety: PASS: Preprocessing pipelines (ColumnTransformer, SimpleImputer, OneHotEncoder) must be fit solely on training folds. Fitting on combined data is strictly prohibited.
